title: Cosmic Wolf Oracle
description: An elderly woman in a purple coat and beret stands on stone steps holding binoculars, gazing up at a large glowing green circular portal containing a luminous wolf and swirling red vortex with black wolf silhouettes. Above floats a dark planet with city lights and rings, connected by a robotic arm, while film reels, a skull, papers, and glowing animal spirits surround the scene against a black background.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene of an old woman in a long purple coat and beret standing on mossy stone stairs, looking through binoculars at a massive glowing green circular portal. Inside the portal is a luminous green wolf and a swirling red and black vortex with silhouetted wolves. A dark planet with a glowing city and rings floats above, connected by a mechanical robotic arm with red eyes. Scattered around are film reels, a human skull, papers with drawings, glowing purple and orange animal spirits, and handprints on a black background with lightning.
